recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-7901 unless the Financial Management work group later chooses to remodel or remove the current supportingInfo-based missing-tooth example and binding.
issue_request: FHIR-7901 was a Published FHIR-core Claim change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking why dental-specific elements such as Claim.missingTeeth were not extensions or otherwise outside the core Claim resource. The accepted resolution was to remove MissingTeeth because missing teeth can be represented in Claim.information.

No historical commit message used the later Jira-key spelling, but the tracker number and patch content match FHIR-7901.
additional_context: Claim is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. Later work renamed Claim.information to Claim.supportingInfo for Request-pattern consistency, so the current representation uses Claim.supportingInfo. Current Claim source still binds Claim.supportingInfo.reason to missing-tooth reason codes, and an oral Claim example demonstrates missing-tooth representation through supportingInfo. Related issues FHIR-11373, FHIR-11395, and FHIR-12356 are already represented on the combined branch.
